title: eludite.browser.form_input input
description: Fill several form fields of a tab's page in one call. Each field is an element by `ref` (from eludite.browser.read_page or find) and a `value`: a string for text boxes, text areas, contenteditable elements and a single `<select>` (an option's value or label), true or false for checkboxes and radio buttons, a list of strings for a multiple `<select>`, and `{"files": [absolute paths]}` for a file input. The value is set on the element and it gets `input` and `change` events, as typing would give it, so frameworks such as React see the change. Faster and steadier than typing with eludite.browser.input; use input when a page must see real keystrokes or clicks. Answers each field's result (a field that is not a form control, is disabled or read-only, or names no option fails alone, with a message) and the console errors emitted. Refs from an older page_generation are refused: call read_page again. Permission class execute; a file outside the workspace makes the call dangerous, as for eludite.browser.upload. Next: eludite.browser.input to click Submit, eludite.browser.read_page to check the values.
x-eludite-escalates: Dangerous when a `files` value names a file outside the workspace folder.

ref.description: A ref (`e1`, `e2`, ...) from eludite.browser.read_page or eludite.browser.find in the current page generation.

anyOf.description: Text, or a single select's option (value or label).
A multiple select's options (values or labels).

tab.description: The tab: its id from eludite.browser.tabs (`t1`, `t2`, ...). Default: the active tab (the one last opened or selected).
